budget.hard_stop: Sum all command wall stages including parallel agents; GPU process-wall also counted in CPU command-wall. No extensions; preserve partial outputs and mark unavailable endpoints NOT_EVALUABLE.

registration.mechanism: Commit and push exact protocol before new data construction/download, retraining or eval access; bind commit and hash. Development confirmation; not protected FINAL or App inheritance.

inherited.residual_fit: Frozen v1.1 empirical signed FARO-native residual bands, old train/cal18 effective frames only; not refit from new cal/eval

features.readout: unchanged v1 peak_readout SNR>=3 coverage>=.75 and projection; no source native/reference/labels/categories/groundtruth depths used as features
features.margin: 16th largest min(z-entry,exit-z) over query-domain finite positive predicted rays; less16 finite rays -> -inf
features.ToF_K: ordinary features arithmetic mean; either missing margin -> baseline -inf and model margin -10 with missingflag1; valid_K_count0/1/2
features.ToF_relationship: before z<entry, inside entry<=z<=exit, after z>exit; fractions divided by query-domain rays; median offsets to entry/exit over finite positive rays, absent=-10
features.support: projected pixel-ray count with predicted depth inside query, not independent subrays
features.RGB: DAV2 and UniDepth own raw margin16, missing indicator, finite-domain fraction
features.query_indices: Remove band_index and all query_x/y/z_index. No explicit position, distance band, domain size or arm identity as model features. Band used only for thresholds/report. Sensor interval-relative margins retained; no causal removal-of-all-priors claim.
features.evidence_gate: For D_prime/B_prime/audit_b: finite unclipped raw ToF margin>=0 OR active RGB margin>=0; ToF K2 mean any missing K gives -inf; active RGB Uni near/DAV midfar. No evidence -> score -inf before cal ties/eval prediction. Minimum geometric support definition identical audit(b).

Logistic.preprocess: StandardScaler fitted on source train POS/FREE only

models.train_labels: POSITIVE=1, FREE_ON_SAMPLED_RAYS=0; UNKNOWN excluded; only train visits
models.no_model_selection: D_prime=primary HGB; B_prime=six-arm LR; audit_b=native-only LR. One shared ensemble per method across all6 arms, v1 parameters/seeds955/956/957 mean; no selection/refit after eval.

scores.RGB: Uni rawmargin for near, DAV rawmargin for mid/far

calibration.threshold_rule: score>=threshold; all finite unique score ties plus +inf all-reject; -inf is never candidate
calibration.objective: among F<=floor(target*FREE), maximize query W on POS, then minimize F, then choose highest threshold; no tie splitting
calibration.zero_FREE: threshold+inf, status NOT_CALIBRATABLE; never count as success
calibration.zero_POS: threshold+inf, status NO_CAL_POS; never count as success
calibration.seal: Training/model hashes,16feature identities, cal cache, all21 exhaustive tie tables/cuts, executed code/dependencies, sealed before exclusive eval OPEN.
calibration.mixture: All6 available arms concatenated raw row counts; FARO base gated. One threshold per method/band shared by all evaluation arms. Baselines independently same mixture/ties/targets.

metric_contract.W: query-level predicted positive AND POS reference; not old pixel-intersection witness; all methods same
metric_contract.U: predicted positive AND UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN excluded from fitting, included in eval support report
metric_contract.no_pixel_claim: learner emits query probability only; legacy pixel-witness numbers not directly comparable

training.visits: All30 already consumed synchronized visits960frames from exact robust feature cache; all original roles train eligible. New visits globally excluded from all consumed and gate-failed visits, more than30 excluded.
training.recipe: D_prime/B_prime known POS/FREE all6 arms weight per row=Nknown/(6*nknown_arm), each arm total=Nknown/6. B weighted StandardScaler. audit_b only native known rows weight1/unweighted scaler; same16features. UNKNOWN excluded. Exactly one fit per method/seed, no new cal/eval labels for training.

new_data.order: Official metadata.csv physical row order; non-NA visit and is_in_upsampling=True; all historically consumed captures propagated to visits and old attempted first-time-complete visits excluded
new_data.capture: First time-complete capture for each unconsumed visit; failure of reference gate consumes whole visit, never alternative capture/windows after label inspection
new_data.windows: Common native RGB/depth/K timestamps sorted; origin first common timestamp; 0.2s grid; nearest timestamp ties earlier; abs delta<=0.10000001s. First two chronological non-overlapping16-point windows, unique RGB timestamps. Seal selection before labels.

gate.scope: reference-only combined two windows, no model outputs

new_data.split: Accepted ordinal0..5 cal;6..17 eval; all capture/window/geometry/noise/reflectance derivatives belong to same visit role; never reassign under budget stop
new_data.insufficient: Do not relax gate; log every skip. Fewer6cal or12eval / incomplete fixed windows means primary confirmation NOT_EVALUABLE; completed results descriptive only.
new_data.inputs: HEAD sizes before transfers; RangeZIP members allowed with archive full-size and planned-range receipts; actual transferred bytes including retries globally capped4GB. Primary native source first; optional FARO afterward in accepted order within remaining CPU/download budget.
new_data.timestamp: Real trajectory interpolation without extrapolation; preserve missing sensor/pose grid rows as UNKNOWN; record RGB/grid/pose residuals; sensor geometric co-location and45degFOV unchanged

ToF.primary: native_perturbed, always labelled semi-circular / 半循环; no independent geometry claim
ToF.native: v1.1 fixed residual pool, optical-Z bands [.3,.8),[.8,1.5),[1.5,3); independently sample pixel residuals with fixed seeds, invalid/nonpositive/outside range UNKNOWN; no native fill of FARO
ToF.synthesis: Six arms inherited exact robust contract: native_perturbed, faro_rho015_ambient1, faro_rho060_ambient1, faro_rho030_ambient3, faro_rho030_ambient1, faro_rho030_ambient10. Quality arms use FARO geometry, missing rows retained, no native fill; .5/2 signal or3/10 ambient scaling from base photon expectation with frozen sample and same frame/K seeds. Frozen ambient8 mapping. FARO base only K0 joint_pass_zones>=52; other5 unfiltered.
ToF.FARO: Inherited v2 full target and officially registered sibling source acquisition in accepted visit order,2cm voxel/surfel stride4; optional within strict4GB/CPU cap. Stop before next whole component exceeds budget, completed prefix preserved; no native-assisted registration or fill. Missing components disclosed and missing geometry retained for quality arms.
ToF.FARO_gate: Fixed K0 joint_pass_zones>=52, no outcome filtering; model+baseline description only; missing assets do not affect primary confirmation
ToF.readout: Frozen v1 SNR>=3, zonecoverage>=.75, 16-order margin; same DAV/Uni frozenrawmodels, no model/readout edits

eval.single_open: exclusive append-only eval_open receipt after verified cal seal; produce immutable query score/label/prediction cache once; no weights or cutpoint changes afterward; later audit/bootstrap reads frozen query table only
eval.best_single: at frozen cal points select higher eval W of ToF/RGB within source/band; ties fewer F then RGB. Equivalent improvement criterion beats both fixed single sensors; no model or threshold selection
eval.paired: on same POS queries, rescue=model_yes comparator_no; loss=model_no comparator_yes; also FREE added/removed and UNKNOWN added/removed; compare best_single and OR

bootstrap.cluster: Resample all12original eval visit IDs with replacement; retain paired query rows and zero-row FARO clusters; comparator identity fixed to full-eval best single
bootstrap.interval: percentile2.5/97.5 for W/POS,F/FREE,paired deltaW/POS and deltaW count; zero-denominator replicates omitted with valid count

eval.saturation: For every FARO band report RGB W/POS and remaining POS=POS-W_RGB; saturated descriptor iff ratio>=.95, predeclared and purely descriptive
eval.forbidden: Protected480/test never accessed; after eval opening no model/cutpoint changes; post-open audit uses immutable query cache only
eval.sources: All6 arms same ensembles and21cuts. Observation-only eval features permitted before OPEN; labels only once after OPEN except reference-only prespecified acquisition gate. Immutable per_query cache for audit/bootstrap.

confirmation.criterion: Complete6cal/12eval cohort; ADOPTED middle cut, POS/FREE>0; D_prime W-max(fixed tof W,rgb W)>0;12visit cluster bootstrap95% deltaW/POS lower>0; F/FREE<=.075.
confirmation.secondary: Separate FARO base and ambient10 near: D_prime W-rgb W>=0 AND F/FREE<=.04; require POS/FREE>0, ADOPTED near cut and contributing visit else NOT_EVALUABLE. Both required for overall secondary pass; no bootstrap clause, observed non-decrease is not statistical noninferiority.
confirmation.pass_claim: 去先验、证据门控的融合在中带得到确认（真实 RGB + 半合成 ToF）
confirmation.report: All near/mid/far numbers for7methods/6arms; B_prime and audit_b same protocol; rescue/loss/FREE cost; four groups both/tof_only/rgb_only/neither, gated models supported neither must0; conditional decomposition not causal attribution. Far report only, no claim.
confirmation.independence: New visits independent of all consumed development visits; official reference gating is label-enriched selection disclosed; semi-circular ToF does not support actual hardware claim
confirmation.failure: List failed clauses separately; missing coverage/cohort NOT_EVALUABLE is not model falsification

retry.before_open: Resume source/feature mechanical interruptions with unchanged selected windows/roles/recipes, preserve failures and hashes; failed fixed fit may mechanically rerun only before outcome access with cause receipt, not a new recipe
retry.after_open: Exclusive open marker; cache query predictions/labels once. No second label/model pass. If incomplete, preserve terminal and report NOT_EVALUABLE; cached summaries/audits may resume unchanged.

decision_check: Old gated LR middle +282/1923 CI10.07-21.39pp supplies plausible headroom; mixed HGB old FARO near FREE15.8% remains failure.12visits independent clusters, no power guarantee; future denominators unknown, zeroPOS/FREE cannot pass. Smallest net1query; secondary non-decrease descriptive. No retuning at budget stop.
